name: .RDP File Created by Outlook Process
description:
Detects the creation of files with the ".rdp" extensions in the temporary directory that Outlook uses when opening attachments.
This can be used to detect spear-phishing campaigns that use RDP files as attachments.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Whenever someone receives an RDP file as an email attachment and decides to save or open it right from the attachments
query: file.path:*.rdp AND ((file.path:(*\\AppData\\Local\\Packages\\Microsoft.Outlook_* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Olk\\Attachments\\*)) OR (file.path:*\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Windows\\* AND file.path:*\\Content.Outlook\\*))
